question: To which archipelago does Diego Garcia island belong?
solution:
The correct answer is **2) Chagos**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chagos Archipelago:** Diego Garcia is the largest island in the Chagos Archipelago, a group of islands located in the central Indian Ocean.
 
• **British Indian Ocean Territory:** The Chagos Archipelago is part of the British Indian Ocean Territory (BIOT), an overseas territory of the United Kingdom.
 
• **Strategic Importance:** Diego Garcia has significant strategic importance due to its location in the Indian Ocean.
 
• **US Military Base:** The island hosts a major United States military base.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bonaparte:** The Bonaparte Archipelago is a group of islands located in the Pacific Ocean, near the coast of New Guinea.
 
• **Mergui:** The Mergui Archipelago is a group of islands located in the Andaman Sea, off the coast of Myanmar.
 
• **Buccaneer:** The Buccaneer Archipelago is a group of islands located in Australia, off the coast of Western Australia.
